lines.text: Qarinah Evidence Desk checks the evidence behind a developer handoff.
This packet records actual local tests and a build at a clean revision. Inspect it, and import only the observations you choose.
Import the observations, then review the release question.
Ready, within this imported evidence, with four citations. This review is not permission to deploy.
Open a citation to inspect its exact source text, timestamp, and content hash. The recorded test output also has its own hash.
The source and memory audit makes retrieval inspectable. This reference uses deterministic hash embeddings, rather than a learned semantic model.
The context view counts bytes, including overhead. With no provider request here, actual token usage remains unknown.
Now, a synthetic replay. These observations are invented.
The handoff recommends ready, but its tests fail. The desk holds the review and shows the conflicting evidence.
In this second synthetic replay, remove the build artifact.
With that required evidence missing, the desk abstains. It explains what is missing instead of guessing a release decision.
Live sponsor evidence remains pending. This dated local demo makes no submission claim.
